dialogues.speaker: Sachya
dialogues.text: Ah, outstanding work! I wasn't sure you'd be able to smash through all those boulders.

dialogues.speaker: Sachya
dialogues.text: Even our tribe's Master Trainers wouldn't have made such easy work of the challenge! You're even stronger than I imagined, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Sachya
dialogues.text: Well, I've had my eyes opened today, that's for sure. Here! Your reward. You've more than earned it!

dialogues.speaker: Sachya
dialogues.text: Ah, what a lovely challenge trail. Shame we can't find its like outside of eruption cycles...

dialogues.speaker: Sachya
dialogues.text: Hey there, outland warrior. Nice eyes you've got. I can see the resolve in 'em! So! Want to try this rolling boulder trail out? Rules are simple! Break through those rolling boulders and reach the end of the track!

dialogues.speaker: Sachya
dialogues.text: It's pretty challenging if I do say so myself. What say you? Want to give this a whirl?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Give me a moment to prep...
